text: ないようは　きえてしまいますが　よろしいですか？

structure.jp: ないようは　きえてしまいますが

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happens completely, often to your regret. きえてしまいます = 'will disappear for good'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a clause means 'but' and leads into the next part. きえてしまいますが = 'it will vanish, but'.
